name: Walletap
description:
Walletap turns a sentence into a wallet pass. Connect the server and Claude can design a pass template, issue passes against it, update them, and push the change to every phone that already holds one — across Apple Wallet and Google Wallet at once.

Ask for "a loyalty card for Aurora Coffee Co., eight stamps to a free latte, using our logo" and Claude uploads the artwork, creates the template with stamp collection configured, and hands back the Add-to-Wallet links. Ask it to "add a stamp to Marko's card and notify him" and the pass in his wallet updates in place.

What the tools cover:

• Templates — create, update, list and inspect pass templates for loyalty cards, event tickets, gift cards, offers, memberships and generic passes. Colours, logos, hero images, stamp collections, NFC and barcode redemption are all set from the conversation. 
• Passes — issue single or batch passes (up to 10 per call), fetch and search them, patch fields, and export. Delivery by email, SMS, or as Add-to-Wallet links. • Push — update one pass or fan a notification out to every active holder of a template. Claude writes the message inline. 
• Files, locations and sub-accounts — upload artwork and get back 1×/2×/3× variants, manage venue locations for geo-triggered lock-screen passes, and administer team sub-accounts. 
• Translation — translate the text on a pass into another language.

Read-only tools are annotated as such, so asking a question never mutates state. Write tools are marked destructive and always prompt.

Walletap is the pass-issuing platform behind loyalty programmes, event ticketing and access credentials for merchants across Europe. The connector talks to Walletap's own API; an account is required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Walletap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Walletap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.walletap.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Walletap MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walletap lists 25 MCP tools, including create_location, create_pass, create_sub_account, create_template, delete_file, delete_location, delete_sub_account, delete_template, export_passes, get_file, get_pass, and get_template.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Walletap?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Walletap in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Walletap requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Walletap is developed by Walletap. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
